ns2:course.label: Advanced Field Geology
ns2:course.description: Group field study in a prominent geologic locality; includes in-class meetings, student-led presentation, and field trip; trips run during spring break, winter break, mid-end May or intercession; dates depend on location. May be repeated. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor. Field trip fee required.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: May be repeated. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor. Field trip fee required.
